articles.title: A look at the main issues in Israeli elections seen as a referendum on Netanyahu
articles.description: Israelis are gearing up to vote in the first national elections since Hamas’ Oct. 7, 2023, attack out of Gaza. The Oct. 27 polls are widely seen as a referendum on the leadership of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Outsiders may expect voters to be focused on questions around Israel's wartime conduct in Gaza or its occupation of much of southern Lebanon and parts of Syria. But instead Israelis are focused on internal issues. Top of mind are the security failures that led to Oct. 7, the deadliest day in the country's history, as well as mandatory military service, efforts to overhaul the judiciary and who is at the head of the various political parties.

articles.title: Israel votes in first election since 7 October attacks and Gaza war
articles.description: Israelis will head to the polls on Tuesday (27 October) in the first election since the 7 October attacks and subsequent wars in Gaza, Iran and Lebanon. Prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces a big challenge from former army chief Gadi Eisenkot, with neither expected to secure a parliamentary majority. But would a change in leadership bring peace in the region? Both candidates oppose an independent Palestinian state, and support continued Israeli security control over Palestinian territories. The Independent’s chief international correspondent Bel Trew reports.

articles.title: Disenchanted Netanyahu supporters are prize of Israel election campaign
articles.description: By Emily Rose and Maayan LubellDIMONA, Oct 25 (Reuters) - In the remote Negev Desert town of Dimona, long a bastion of Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party, disenchanted voters are going door-to-door campaigning for his top rival, hoping to bring down the veteran prime minister in Israel's election on Tuesday. The ballot is Israel's first since Hamas' October 7, 2023, surprise attack that shook the country and plunged the region into turmoil, as Israel went to war on the militant group in Gaza and its allies in Lebanon and Iran.
